units.raw_text: Led Amazon Kepler launch — ground-up rewrite replacing Fire TV's Android stack with a native Linux-based OS. Ported all three NCP apps, hit the September 2025 announcement, shipped on-time in October with zero negative impact to engagement metrics. Fire TV is Disney's fourth-largest living room platform (~18M monthly active devices).
units.normalized_summary: Led Amazon Kepler launch — ground-up rewrite replacing Fire TV Android stack with native Linux-based OS

units.raw_text: Ran NCP plus ADK platform health reporting across Conviva, Sentry, and Datadog. Weekly exec-format narration, Q2/Q3 KPI tracking (FPS, Glimpse attribution, DataDog migration, AI PR cycle time), and automation to port Sentry dashboards to Datadog ahead of the July 2026 cutover.
units.normalized_summary: Ran NCP and ADK platform health reporting across Conviva, Sentry, Datadog with weekly exec narration and Sentry-to-DataDog cutover automation

item.text: Drove the multi-year roadmap for x86/Arm hybrid CPU architectures at hyperscale, shipping 12 new SKUs into a 100-million-VM fleet and increasing per-instance throughput by 40% on SAP HANA workloads. Negotiated $400M in three-year cloud-migration contracts with VPs at five Fortune-50 enterprises, displacing AWS in two of them.
